speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me today; I understand you have rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass. To help me determine the cause, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea, or have you experienced unintended weight loss recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Cancer. The patient is a 45-year-old female with a two-week history of painless rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass; these are classic presenting symptoms for malignancy, so I am requesting an immediate digital rectal exam, flexible sigmoidoscopy, and biopsy of the mass. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, CEA. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_MRI.
